list.title: Chat modes and kinds
list.intro: The chat's session kinds. Every surface that names a session kind uses these.

list.title: Things
list.intro: Concept glyphs: they name a thing and stay lit and still until their host is hovered.

list.title: Actions and controls
list.intro: Controls: unlit at rest, they ignite on hover or focus and play their act once.

list.title: Things the chat never named
list.intro: Settings categories, Usage, the onboarding art and the rail use these. Each has one verb: the part that moves is the part that does the thing. Where two PM7 icons named one concept, they now share one drawing.

list.title: Controls the chat lacked
list.intro: Arrows in every direction and the drag grip. Controls stay unlit until hovered or focused, then ignite and play their act once.

list.title: Terminal
list.intro: The terminal tab kind and the command marks (Jared, PLN-3: redesign them).
list.empty: Being drawn by the second designer.

list.title: Panels and tab kinds
list.intro: The universal panels' tab kinds and tab marks.

list.title: Left rail
list.intro: The rail needs no new drawings: its activity items and panel icons are chat glyphs or objects (see Before and after), and its status set becomes the shared vocabulary (DL-162). Its solid knock-out badges give way to the neon tube marks, one drawing per state everywhere.
